cagents-cagents:lever:f42af5ac-ece0-4abe.title: CQV/Validation Engineer
cagents-cagents:lever:f42af5ac-ece0-4abe.description: About CAI: CAI is a 100% employee-owned company established in 1996, that has grown year over year to nearly 700 people worldwide. We provide commissioning, qualification, validation, start-up, project management and consulting services related to operational readiness to FDA regulated and other mission critical industries. Are you Ready? Our approach is simple; we put the client’s interests first, we do not stop until it is right, and we will do whatever it takes to get there. As owners of CAI, we are committed to living our Foundational Principles, both professionally and personally: · We act with integrity, · We serve each other, · We serve society, · We work for our future. With employee ownership, one person’s success is everyone’s success; we work diligently to accomplish team goals. We place Team Before Self, demonstrate Respect for Others, and possess a can-do attitude. That is how we have grown exponentially. CAI agents will be exposed to cutting edge technologies in the advanced medicine space. You will have an opportunity to work with recognized subject matter experts allowing YOU to be a key player in bringing lifesaving therapies to market. As part of our company culture, we invest in YOUR future, and commit to hands on certifications as well as professional training. Our collaborative culture ensures that our customers benefit from exemplary work across our entire range of professional services. Requirements include: We are now seeking a CQV Engineer to join our growing operations in Ireland The role of a CQV Engineer in CAI is to: · Conduct and lead Commissioning, Qualification, Validation team activities with a direct regard for Safety. · Managing the C&Q documentation and execution lifecycle from SLIA generation through to OQ completion. · Generating C&Q Procedures for projects. · Approval of TOPs. · Facilitate scoping / planning of commissioning spares and consumables. · Deliver the C&Q activities as required to meet the schedule · Track progress of C&Q activities as required. · Preparation of Qualification Summary Reports (QSR), and management of Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM) · Execution of Design reviews, shakedown, commissioning, FAT's, IQ, OQ, PQ activities. · Management of any aspect of C & Q, verification as requested i.e., Change Controls, Management of Contractors and Vendors, document control, punch list management. · Coordinate with project contractors and equipment vendors to execute required tests. · Allocate project resources for efficient execution of project deliverables. · Coordinate support during C&Q execution - Position Requirements: · BS or MS in a relevant science or engineering field, or equivalent · 3+ years in CQV SME roles for life sciences – Clean Utilities/Filling experience preferable · Excellent oral and written communication skills · Excellent problem-solving skills · Customer-service focused. · Proficient in life science manufacturing processes in areas such as biotech, aseptic fill/finish, OSD, Gene Therapy or equivalent experience. · Able to travel domestically and internationally if required. #LI-JD1

jobgether-jobgether:lever:298502c3-5ec1-.title: Analista de QA Sênior
jobgether-jobgether:lever:298502c3-5ec1-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analista de QA Sênior based in Brazil. This is a senior quality assurance role focused on ensuring that technology solutions meet high standards of reliability, performance, security, and user experience. You will lead testing strategies across the development lifecycle, combining manual and automated testing to identify and prevent defects. The role offers the opportunity to work closely with development teams and influence quality from requirements through post-release support. You will contribute to test planning, automation, quality standards, and continuous improvement initiatives. Your expertise will also help strengthen QA processes and introduce modern tools and best practices. This is an environment suited to a proactive professional who enjoys solving complex problems and raising the quality bar across technology solutions. Develop and execute comprehensive test plans covering products, services, and technical solutions, ensuring quality requirements are addressed throughout the development lifecycle. Perform both automated and manual testing to identify bugs, defects, performance issues, and other quality risks before implementation. Create detailed test scenarios based on functional and technical requirements and contribute to defining quality criteria for new solutions. Work closely with development and technical teams to investigate issues, communicate findings clearly, and ensure defects are resolved before release. Document test cases, execution results, defects, and quality findings while providing actionable feedback to development stakeholders. Support the definition and evolution of QA strategies, including test automation approaches and quality assurance standards. Participate in quality reviews and discussions, communicating testing progress, risks, issues, and recommendations to relevant stakeholders. Monitor product quality and performance after implementation, providing ongoing QA support and identifying opportunities for improvement. Stay current with emerging QA methodologies, automation tools, security practices, and industry standards, applying relevant improvements to testing processes. Provide senior-level QA guidance and contribute to quality initiatives that support technical teams and broader business objectives. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; postgraduate education or specialization in a relevant area is desirable. Advanced professional experience in quality assurance, with strong knowledge of software testing methodologies and quality management practices. Experience developing QA strategies and leading or coordinating testing activities across technology projects. Strong hands-on knowledge of both manual and automated testing approaches, including test planning, execution, defect identification, and validation. Experience with test automation tools and frameworks, with the ability to identify opportunities to improve testing efficiency and coverage. Knowledge of information security and its application to software quality and testing processes. Advanced English communication skills, both written and verbal. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and a structured approach to identifying root causes. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with development teams and senior stakeholders. Ability to take ownership, demonstrate leadership in QA initiatives, and provide clear recommendations to technical and business audiences. Advanced QA, test automation, information security, or quality management certifications are highly desirable. Relevant advanced courses or professional development in QA, automation, information security, or quality management are an advantage. Benefits: Opportunity to work in a techno

jobgether-jobgether:lever:79948139-d119-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Team Lead Product Analyst based in Poland. This is a growth-oriented product analytics leadership opportunity for an experienced analyst ready to expand their impact beyond hands-on analysis. You will initially focus on product and business analytics while progressively taking ownership of larger analytical initiatives, stakeholder relationships, and team leadership responsibilities. The role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing, Growth, Data, and business strategy, giving you broad visibility into how data drives decisions. You will investigate complex product and business questions, identify opportunities, and translate insights into actionable recommendations. Over time, you will mentor analysts, shape analytical standards, and develop the skills required to lead a product analytics function. This is an ideal environment for someone with strong analytical and business judgment who is motivated to grow into a people leadership role.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:e3d22bba-4aab-.title: Product Manager - Ecommerce & Web Applications
jobgether-jobgether:lever:e3d22bba-4aab-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Manager - Ecommerce & Web Applications based in Canada. This role offers the opportunity to shape enterprise-scale e-commerce and web experiences that directly influence digital growth and customer engagement. You will own product strategy and roadmap development across web and commerce platforms, with a strong focus on conversion, performance, and scalability. Working closely with engineering, UX/UI, marketing, and business stakeholders, you will turn customer and market needs into high-impact product initiatives. You will use data and customer insights to optimize journeys, checkout experiences, and commercial performance. The role combines strategic product leadership with hands-on backlog management, requirements definition, and delivery oversight. You will operate in a collaborative, Agile environment where your decisions can have a measurable impact on revenue, customer experience, and digital transformation. Define and execute the e-commerce and web product strategy in alignment with digital revenue and business objectives. Develop and maintain a web product roadmap focused on conversion, performance, scalability, and customer experience. Own and prioritize the product backlog, balancing business value, customer needs, technical considerations, and return on investment. Write detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirements for web and commerce features. Partner with engineering teams to deliver scalable, secure, reliable, and high-availability web platforms. Collaborate with UX/UI teams to improve customer journeys, site usability, navigation, and checkout experiences. Establish, monitor, and optimize key performance indicators such as conversion rate, cart abandonment, average order value, and digital revenue. Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify emerging trends, customer needs, and opportunities for growth. Define commerce roadmaps and contribute to go-to-market strategies for new products and features. Oversee integrations with payment gateways, CRM systems, marketing platforms, and other third-party technologies. Manage relationships with external e-commerce platforms, technology providers, and vendors. Ensure web products align with applicable security, privacy, and data protection requirements. Maintain accurate and up-to-date product, feature, and technical documentation. Requirements: 5+ years of product management experience focused on e-commerce, web applications, or digital platforms. Proven experience delivering scalable web platforms or enterprise e-commerce solutions. Strong knowledge of Agile product development methodologies, including Scrum or Kanban. Hands-on experience managing product backlogs, sprint cycles, prioritization, and delivery processes. Strong ability to create detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirements. Demonstrated analytical capabilities using web analytics, customer insights, conversion data, and revenue metrics to inform product decisions. Experience defining digital commerce roadmaps, product strategies, and go-to-market initiatives. Ability to establish and track conversion, engagement, customer experience, and revenue KPIs. Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, UX/UI, marketing, and business teams. Experience with enterprise e-commerce platforms is an advantage. Familiarity with SEO, conversion rate optimization, digital marketing integrations, payment processors, and CRM platforms is desirable. Exposure to omnichannel commerce or regulated and high-transaction industries is a plus. Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Professional fluency in both English and Spanish. Benefits: Competitive compensatio

msgentertainmentholdingsllc-msgentertain.title: Guest Services Supervisor
msgentertainmentholdingsllc-msgentertain.description: Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (MSG Entertainment) is a leader in live entertainment, delivering unforgettable experiences while forging deep connections with diverse and passionate audiences. The Company’s portfolio includes a collection of world-renowned venues – New York’s Madison Square Garden, Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden, Radio City Music Hall, and Beacon Theatre; and The Chicago Theatre – that showcase a broad array of sporting events, concerts, family shows, and special events for millions of guests annually. In addition, the Company features the original production, the Christmas Spectacular Starring the Radio City Rockettes , which has been a holiday tradition for more than 90 years. More information is available at www.msgentertainment.com . Who are we hiring? The Guest Services Supervisor will be accountable for providing an exceptional guest experience throughout the MSG Venues by leading and directing front-line Guest Services Staff. The role will focus on partnering across departments to get work done through others in a fast-paced, and dynamic environment. Success in this role is demonstrated by an exceptional guest experience, a commitment to continuous learning and development, and achievement of business results. The Guest Services Supervisor will report into the Guest Services Management Team. What will you do? Accountable for daily supervision and leadership of front-line Guest Services Staff Demonstrate a positive attitude and operate with high energy throughout the entire shift Function as a role model to front line colleagues by demonstrating an optimistic demeanor, and achievement of company objectives and goals Ability to work collaboratively with Security and other departments during events and in an emergency. Assess, evaluate and coach front-line Guest Services Staff Provide consistent, fair and timely feedback to front-line Guest Services Staff Manage the content and delivery of pre-shift meetings Ensures that front-line Guest Services Staff are performing their overall job functions, maintaining uniform standards, and delivering exceptional guest experiences. Highly responsive to emergencies in a fast-paced, time sensitive environment. Takes ownership of supervisory locations and maintains a clean, safe and aesthetically pleasing working environment. Addresses customer concerns and questions in a timely and efficient matter while offering recovery solutions when necessary. Assists with pre-event setup duties including front-line Guest Services Staff assignments. Inspects and ensures guest environments are up to venue standards and all emergency exit pathways are clear and accessible prior to opening. Works with Accessibility Services group as necessary for possible seat relocations. Recommend and enforce disciplinary actions as necessary. Act as a liaison between upper management and staff. Ensure all company policies and standards are being met. Provide exceptional experiences for our guests, partners, and team members, including by adhering to our appearance and presentation guidelines while on-site. What do you need to succeed? The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 3-5 years’ Supervisory experience, and/or knowledge of events, sports, theatre operations, within an entertainment venue. Candidates who have completed a minimum of 60 credit hours of college-level coursework (representing 2 years), or have shown similar self-development through certifications, trade school coursework, etc. are preferred. Demonstrate experience completing reports and documenting staff performance Ability to engage and develop collaborative relationships and influence within team and across departments Adept at maintaining a positive, open, approachable, and professional relationship with a diverse group Comfortable with managing conflict and responding to customer problems with a sense of urgency Ability to demonstrate success in managing multiple tasks while under tight deadlines Ability

qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:7c2d3f61-bc26-4db2.description: CNC Press Brake Technician Location: Baltimore, MD Job Type: Contract-to-Hire Starting Pay: From $22.00 per hour Position Overview We are hiring a CNC Press Brake Technician to support precision sheet metal fabrication. This position is responsible for setting up and operating press brake equipment to bend and form metal parts according to engineering drawings and production requirements. The ideal candidate has experience producing accurate, high-quality components while maintaining safe and efficient manufacturing practices.
responsibilities: Set up and operate CNC press brake equipment
Read and interpret blueprints, work orders, and technical drawings
Select the correct tooling, dies, and machine settings for each job
Verify dimensions using calipers, micrometers, tape measures, and other measuring tools
Inspect parts throughout production to ensure accuracy and quality
Maintain a safe, clean, and organized work area
Follow production procedures and company safety guidelines
qualifications: At least 1 year of experience operating CNC press brake machines
Ability to read blueprints and manufacturing documentation
Experience using precision measuring equipment, including calipers, micrometers, and tape measures
Basic math skills and strong mechanical aptitude
Excellent attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality parts
Ability to stand for extended periods during the workday

summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.title: Entry Ride Operator
summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.description: IMPORTANT - REQUIRED NEXT STEP As part of our hiring process, all applicants are required to complete the Predictive Index (PI) Behavioral Assessment. The PI Behavioral Assessment is not a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits, and Perks - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we need? The Entry Ride Operator is the conductor and entertainer for our members while making sure all vehicles are being processed safely and efficiently into the car wash tunnel. The Entry Ride Operator interacts with all customers and is responsible for exterior site cleanliness and creating a memorable experience in all interactions while preparing the vehicles prior to entering the car wash tunnel. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You must be highly motivated, have an outgoing, and a friendly personality. We will provide extensive hands-on and online training for all team members. Location: Speeders Car Wash (Lodi 1) 250 Rt 17, Lodi, NJ, 07644
